iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran still carries 60 percent enrich leverage and unresolved IAEA inspect access. Diplomatic talk channels persist, but nuclear concessions remain tied to unreasonable front-wide terms; no verified higher-level enrichment or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Iran continues Hormuz controlled transit pressure while US blockade/interdictions remain active. Negotiating channels persist, but IRGC threats and unreasonable terms keep the conventional war track imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon remains a ceasefire violation environment: strikes despite ceasefire, prolonged Haddatha ground engagement, and continuing security-track negotiation. Tactical force pressure persists despite the Washington process.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey scan produced no fresh strategic trigger. Cross-border PKK/Syria/Iraq operations remain background only, with no new force surge, atomic warning, or weapons-test signal.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan scan produced stale prior-crisis coverage rather than fresh escalation. Current posture is deconfliction/fragile pause context, with no new Kashmir strike cycle or force surge surfaced.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains driven by strategic nuclear rhetoric and large unannounced strategic nuclear exercises, plus Baltic-threat information operations linked to the Ukraine war.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains critical on standing PLA military buildup pressure, but the scan did not surface a fresh blockade step or large new drill in the last 24h.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK scan found older April weapons-platform coverage but no fresh weapons event or device event in the scan window; risk decays from prior launch-platform activity.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine escalation increased: Putin ordered retaliation after Ukraine hit Starobilsk/Rubicon assets; Russia pummelled Kyiv with missiles/drones, while Kyiv deep-strike campaigns target military-industrial and oil infrastructure. Oreshnik nuclear threat signaling remains in the risk envelope.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAK-AFGHAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions remain elevated after UN-reported civilian casualties and renewed border-clash concerns. Regional negotiation/mediation channels reduce but do not remove the military buildup risk.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical: RSF/SAF military buildup pressure, infrastructure strike pattern, and external backing risks persist around Khartoum, Darfur, and oil-producing areas.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza strikes despite ceasefire and stalled ceasefire talks keep the zone imminent; latest Reuters item is May 17, so no extra 24h spike was added.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: MSF reports aid access blockages and coercive orders amid violence linked to SPLA-IO tensions; this sustains military buildup and diplomacy refused risk.
